author: NETWORG
name: Power Platform: ModelDriven App
description: Creates a Model-Driven App: AppModule.xml (form factor, client, roles) + AppModuleSiteMap.xml (navigation structure). Build navigation with pp-sitemap-area -> pp-sitemap-group -> pp-sitemap-subarea after.

PublisherPrefix.description: Publisher prefix for the app (Example: new, talxis) - used in naming conventions

LogicalName.description: Logical name of the app without publisher prefix (e.g., warehouseapp). The prefix is added automatically.

SolutionRootPath.description: Relative path from the project folder (.csproj) to the folder containing unpacked Dataverse solution files (Other/, Entities/, OptionSets/). Use '.' if solution files are directly in the project folder, or a subfolder name like 'Declarations'. Do not use 'Entities' or 'Other' — those are subdirectories inside the solution metadata root.

manualInstructions.text: Applying the scaffold via 'txc workspace component apply-scaffold'

postActions.description: Applying the scaffold via the TALXIS CLI
